title: Context
youtube_title: Context: The Most Important Skill in Agentic Engineering | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 3
description: Same model, same agent, same bug. One engineer gets a patch that makes things worse; the other gets a four-line fix, because of what the agent could see. This chapter covers context engineering: the workbench, the three-level ladder, infrastructure versus injection, the context window tax, and carrying context across sessions.
